Combine tests

Source: R/cohort_criteria.R
any_of.Rd

any_of() is met when any part is met, not met when every part is not met, and undetermined otherwise. all_of() is met when every part is met, not met when any part is not met, and undetermined otherwise. Combinations nest.

Usage

any_of(...)

all_of(...)

Arguments

...

Two or more tests from master_row(), view_rows(), any_of() or all_of().

Value

An object of class cohort_test.

See also

criterion()

Examples

any_of(
  view_rows("echo_measure", "measured_on", c(-30, 0), "nearest", "lvef <= 25"),
  all_of(
    view_rows("echo_measure", "measured_on", c(-30, 0), "nearest", "lvef <= 35"),
    master_row("mitral_surgery = 1")
  )
)
